name: Redwood National Park
policyReason: The pets page opens three named beaches to leashed pets, and a beach counts as trails, not roads.
summary: Leashed pets may visit Freshwater, Gold Bluffs and Crescent beaches, campgrounds, picnic areas and roads, but no trails.

excerpts.quote: Freshwater Beach, Gold Bluffs Beach, and Crescent Beach.
For the safety of your pet and the preservation of park wildlife, pets are not permitted on trails.

dogRules.text: Allowed in campgrounds, on beaches, in picnic areas and on roads.
Smith River NRA trails allow leashed pets.
